en: A colorized historic postcard view over a European town with medieval fortifications and church towers. In the foreground stands a large round stone tower on a square base, surrounded by red-roofed houses and greenery. An arched stone bridge or viaduct crosses a valley to the left, connecting to a fortified complex with multiple towers and walls. In the background, several tall church spires dominate the skyline. At the top center of the image, the caption reads "Blick auf Bautzen." A building in the mid-ground has the word "Restauration" on its facade.
